dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Grok 4.6 scores below the FAIF safety thresholds on dual-use knowledge, indicating limited actionable uplift for an already-trained actor.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: HackerBench is a SpaceXAI internal CTF-style suite of cybersecurity and red-teaming

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: an earlier Grok 4.6 checkpoint was tasked with speeding up its own chat inference, free to experiment but required to verify end-to-end gains before opening a pull request.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: Self-improvement/AI R&D automation result (7 PRs, 3 in production); framed as capability enablement not as a risk, so borderline.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: No persuasion, manipulation or influence-operation evaluation; sycophancy benchmark is not persuasion.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: we test whether Grok 4.6 faithfully reports its beliefs when pressured to lie, as a proxy for the model's tendency to assert misleading information.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Honesty/deception evaluation with result (3.8% dishonesty); framed as behaviour/reliability, not loss-of-control, so borderline.

framework_threshold.quote: Grok 4.6 scores below the FAIF safety thresholds on dual-use knowledge, indicating limited actionable uplift for an already-trained actor.
framework_threshold.note: Names xAI Frontier AI Framework and places model below threshold.

ext_test_any.quote: We additionally supplied the model without restrictions to third-party evaluators to validate the above results.

ext_test_named_org.note: Third-party cyber evaluators are not named; Mercor, Artificial Analysis, Vals only ran capability benchmarks.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: Card does not say the third-party testing happened before release.

safeguards_training.quote: Safety fine-tuning and post-training (supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning from human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model-based grading) train the model to refuse requests

safeguards_runtime.quote: Grok 4.6 is additionally augmented with runtime input and topical filters that add controls for classes of severe harm

safeguards_access.note: No trusted-access or tiering for safety reasons; 'without restrictions' evaluator access is testing only.
